description: The pie chart compares the proportions of two categories related to a specific aspect of the Paper Copilot system. The chart is divided into two slices. The larger slice, labeled "Reduction", is colored orange and occupies approximately 70% of the chart, with a value of 60.9s and a percentage label of 69.92% inside the slice. The smaller slice, labeled "Efficient deployment", is colored blue and represents around 30% of the chart, with a value of 26.2s. The slices are visually distinct, with the "Reduction" slice being significantly larger and the "Efficient deployment" slice being offset or "exploded" from the rest of the chart. No legend is present in the chart. The values and percentage are displayed directly on the chart, making it clear that the proportions are being compared in terms of time, measured in seconds.
